scope: Real SDK sessions and unchanged frozen production server code through tsx; isolated loopback; sequential fresh-server A/B then B/A. Six diverse profiles. No browser, GPU, artificial Internet latency/loss, build or test run. Payload rates are decimal KB/s and exclude WebSocket/TCP/TLS framing. CPU is server-only telemetry, not total server+client cost. No capacity, GPU/FPS or public-network claim.
